CODEC-178.label: I
CODEC-178.reason: This report is about charset constant deprecation in a completely different area of the library. It has no regional overlap with `DoubleMetaphone` or phonetic matching, and no mechanism overlap with empty-string handling or null checks.

CODEC-181.label: I
CODEC-181.reason: This concerns `BaseNCodec` constructor behavior and padding bytes in encoding/decoding. That is a different subsystem from `language.DoubleMetaphone`, with unrelated data flow and failure mechanism.

CODEC-183.label: I
